summary: Medical knowledge library, exam Qbank and clinical reference tools with an official AI Mode, for students, residents and clinicians — a learning and reference resource, not a substitute for a doctor.
description: Medical knowledge library, exam Qbank and clinical reference tools with an official AI Mode, for students, residents and clinicians — a learning and reference resource, not a substitute for a doctor.

pricing.details: Labelled Premium: a 5-day free trial is offered; no lasting 0 € membership was stated. Official US and International English pricing pages, amounts converted into euro. Students / residents: Monthly Membership or Monthly Access 18 €/month billed monthly — unlimited library access, 50 Qbank questions a month; Yearly Membership 11 €/month billed yearly; Yearly Membership + Qbank Bundle 405 € billed yearly (membership renews annually at 135 € unless cancelled); Student Life 1,085 €. Clinicians: Monthly Access 27 €/month billed monthly; Yearly Access 20 €/month billed yearly. Official 30-day money-back guarantee for purchases made directly through AMBOSS. A German-language clinician pricing page exists in euro; its list was not isolated cleanly and is not used. AMBOSS is a medical knowledge library and exam Qbank with clinical reference tools and an official AI Mode — a learning and reference resource, not a diagnosis and not a substitute for a doctor.
